features.f1Body: Open and start. 80 credits a month, no login required for text and image covers. See a finished piece before you upgrade.
features.f2Body: Type a topic to get a headline and badge; upload a reference photo as the background. Swap styles and platform sizes in one click.
features.f3Body: Xiaohongshu 3:4, short video 9:16, WeChat 2.35:1, thumbnails 16:9 — exported as PNG at each platform’s pixel spec.
features.f4Body: Emotion for Xiaohongshu, hooks for short video, benefit for WeChat, contrast and numbers for thumbnails. Cover and title are written together.
features.f5Body: Knowledge, lifestyle, reviews and business columns all have a style. Members can remove the watermark and export a pack.

faq.a1: Four built-in platform sizes: Xiaohongshu 1242×1660, short video 1080×1920, WeChat header 900×383, video thumbnail 1280×720. Creator and Pro can export the full-size pack in one go.
faq.q2: Do I need design or editing skills?
faq.a2: No. CoverFast lays out title levels, badges and safe zones from your topic. Change a few words, pick a style, and export a PNG you can post.
faq.q3: How close is image-to-cover to my reference?
faq.a3: The first release uses a local template engine: your photo fills the background, then lighting, title and badge are layered on. It stays readable and postable; a real image model can plug into CoverProvider later without a page rewrite.
faq.a4: Yes. You are responsible for the topics and reference images you provide. Paid members export watermark-free files for accounts and commercial content. The free plan exports with a CoverFast watermark.
faq.a5: Yes. Standard costs 10 credits, HD 20, four-platform batch 30, shown before you generate. Free accounts get 80 credits a month and 3 downloads a day; paid plans add more credits and unlimited downloads.
faq.a6: Email support@coverfast.app. We usually reply within one business day and help you ship the cover to the right platform.
faq.q7: How long does one cover take?
faq.a7: Local templates usually finish within a second. The UI shows a standard queue for free users and a priority queue for Pro. You can leave anytime; the piece appears in My covers.
faq.a8: Credits are spent only when a cover is generated: 10 standard, 20 HD, 30 batch. Free users get basic styles; members unlock Poster, Minimal business and Night tech, plus no watermark. Estimated cost is always shown first.
faq.a9: The web workbench is the focus today. CoverProvider and PaymentPort are already shaped as swap-in interfaces so image models and WeChat / Alipay / Stripe can connect later without rebuilding pages.

about.title: Covers should not slow down your posting
about.p1: CoverFast is a cover workbench for creators. Whether a note or a short video gets the tap is often decided in three seconds of cover and title.
about.p2: Most people can write — they get stuck on canvas size, type safety and platform voice. Xiaohongshu wants emotion, short video wants a hook, WeChat wants a benefit, thumbnails want contrast and numbers. CoverFast turns those conventions into a template engine so you can post first and polish later.
about.p3: We shipped v1 fully local: no forced login, no external AI key, no live payment merchant. The free quota keeps a watermark so you can run the whole loop before you pay for clean exports, batch packs and more credits.
about.who1: Knowledge creators and course authors who need a steady, useful cover language
about.who2: Lifestyle and review accounts that A/B several covers quickly
about.who3: Editors and operators who need a four-platform pixel pack in one pass
about.p4: When real text-to-image or WeChat / Alipay land, they will use the CoverProvider and PaymentPort already reserved — no page rewrite.
about.metaDescription: CoverFast helps creators turn topics into covers people tap.
